evidence: Modifies CreateNewBlock and BlockTemplateManager interfaces and implementation in src/node/miner.* and src/node/block_template_manager.*.
rationale: Replaces nullable pointers with util::NotNullUniquePtr for CreateNewBlock and removes dead null checks. As the PR notes, 'pointers that never return null are typed as standard nullable smart pointers', making this an internal refactor to clarify API invariants without changing mining behavior or performance.
